raw.compression: lzf (re-saved by zenodo_get source; Zenodo lists gzip-9)

own_amideI_area_mask_agreement.rule: trapezoid area under 1600-1700 cm^-1 after min-to-zero > 2

amide_I_peak_over_tissue.quantity: tissue absorbance at Amide I max

noise_estimate.definition: per tissue pixel: 1.4826*MAD of first differences of raw absorbance over 1800-1900 cm^-1, divided by sqrt(2)

confirmed: the preprocessed grid is an exact subset of the raw grid (no interpolation)
it is raw channels 12-1314 with three bands removed: 1340-1490 and 2700-3000 (paraffin, PyIR remove_wax) and 2250-2450 (CO2, PyIR remove_co2); 78+104+156 = 338 channels, 1303-338 = 965
the tissue is still in paraffin: sharp wax bands reach 4.8 AU at 2920/2850 cm^-1
the published tissue-mask rule (area under 1600-1700 after min-to-zero > 2, integrated over channel index) reproduces the shipped mask at IoU 0.984
preprocessed_definition.inferred_not_confirmed: values are a Savitzky-Golay SECOND derivative of a min-to-zero, vector-normalised spectrum (normalise before differentiate; magnitude matches to 0.4 % at window 13; mean-spectrum correlation 0.977 at window 11). The exact window, polynomial order and any denoising step are not pinned down, and the paper's Methods section is paywalled from watford.
preprocessed_definition.consequence: use *_raw.h5 only; the preprocessed files have already removed the scatter baseline and the absolute scale.

paper.citation: O'Leary L, Ferguson D, Hart C, Brown M, Oliveira P, Clarke N, Sachdeva A, Gardner P, Yin H. Anal. Chem. 2026, 98(4), 2743-2755.

raw_mask_shape_mismatch.problem: in every *_raw.h5 the /mask shape differs from /spectra (256,256)
raw_mask_shape_mismatch.workaround: use /mask from the matching <core>.h5 (256x256), or regenerate it with the published Amide I area rule

saturation.note: exactly 8.0 AU, so some channels are clipped or saturated; screen before fitting

pcuk2023_source_cubes.note: this is the source the 199 GB Zenodo release was built from (pcuk2023_dataset_creation reads 'Slide {n}/DataCube/{file}'); annotations/ and H_E/ sit alongside. The full download is avoidable.

br20832.note: raw instrument format (.dat/.dmd/.drd/.seq/.bsp), not the Zenodo release form
